about: The machine-readable index of docs/. bin/tezgah-docs reads this; tests/test_docs.py keeps it in step with the directory. Every path is repo-relative.

pages.title: Architecture: the layers and what runs when
pages.audience: maintainer, agent new to the repo
answers: what are the layers and what does each own
what runs when from session start to Stop
what does a session pay for and what is on demand
where is state kept and who writes each store

pages.title: Hosts: what each one gets and what each one can see
pages.audience: maintainer, agent adding a host or a mark
answers: what does each host get and where is it written
which host can observe what
what is a host adapter responsible for
what does it take to add a host

pages.title: Contract: what a session is told, and how a rule is disarmed
answers: what exactly is a session told and from which file
how is a rule disarmed
how is a rule added and what keeps the copies in step
what happens when the injected text grows too large

pages.title: Gate: every way a tool call can be refused
answers: why was my command denied
which decisions need the user's explicit approval and how is it given
what does the gate not catch on purpose
how do I add a gate rule

pages.title: Evidence: the ledger, the Stop rule, snapshots
answers: what stops an unverified done
what does the ledger hold and what never reaches it
how does a check get recorded as passed versus merely run
how do I undo a bad write

pages.title: Status line: what each mark means and how it is drawn
answers: what does each status mark mean and why is it in that state
how does a surface draw the line
how do I see or debug the line for a session

pages.title: Skills: what ships, and how one reaches a host
answers: what is a skill here and how does it reach a host
which skills ship and what does each do
how do I add a skill without breaking the router or the install report

pages.title: Testing: the checks, the probes, the e2e scripts
answers: how do I check this repo and what does each check catch
how do I write a test here that will not be deleted later
what do the probes and the e2e scripts need to run

pages.title: Operations: install, upgrade, repair
answers: how do I install verify and upgrade this on a machine
what does each installer flag do
something is broken what do I check first

pages.title: Glossary: one term per concept
answers: what does this word mean in this repository
